edfa_10.7dB.label: EDFA gain 10.7 dB
edfa_10.7dB.description: EDFA mean gain fixed at 10.70 dB (nbar = 0.5875); Raman mean on-off gain 6 dB (first order)

edfa_6.7dB.label: EDFA gain 6.7 dB
edfa_6.7dB.description: EDFA mean gain fixed at 6.70 dB (nbar = 0.5335); Raman mean on-off gain 10 dB (first order)

conditions.span: 80 km G.652 fiber (card RAMAN-G652: alpha_s 0.19 dB/km, alpha_p 0.25 dB/km, C_R 0.406 1/(W km) at 1450 nm)
conditions.raman_profile: SSMF gain-efficiency profile distributed with GNPy, scaled as in card HYBRID-C80 (raman_scaling)
conditions.edfa: 8 m EDF of ref. [124] (card EDFA-PERIN2019), average-inversion relation, internal EDF gain
conditions.channels: 40 channels 1530-1565 nm, equally spaced in frequency (112.4 GHz)
conditions.launch: 0 dBm per channel at the fiber input (16.0 dBm total)
conditions.target: mean span net gain 0 dB (transparent span)
conditions.full_model: all channels and pumps, counter-propagating pumps, pump depletion, pump-pump, pump-signal and signal-signal SRS with photon-number factor, attenuation; solve_bvp
conditions.full_model_optimization: sequential LP with forward-difference Jacobian of the full model (step 2 mW), trust region, exact penalty mu = 50 on the mean; local optimum
conditions.excluded: ASE and noise figure, double Rayleigh scattering (estimated separately), pump RIN, temperature, polarization, spectral shape of a real GFF, spectral hole burning, EDFA dynamics

definitions.ripple: maximum multichannel gain variation: max - min of the span net gain over the 40 channels (ITU-T G.661)
definitions.budget: upper limit of the total Raman pump power launched into the fiber; the optimizer may use less
definitions.full_model_in_the_loop: sequential LP with forward-difference Jacobian of the full model (step 2 mW), trust region, exact penalty mu = 50 on the mean; local optimum; started from the first-order design and from the solution at the previous budget, so the curve cannot increase with budget
definitions.families: free: EDFA mean inversion is an LP variable; fixed: inversion set so that the EDFA mean gain is 10.7 or 6.7 dB and the Raman section supplies the rest
definitions.infeasible: budget below which no pump setting reaches the 0 dB mean span net gain (fixed families only)
